description: Two bounded 48-site Studio ensemble smoke checks; not a statistical timing benchmark.

blocks.explanation: No strengthening established; a zero bound does not prove lattice feasibility.

convention.sro: 1 - P(neighbor species | center species, shell, sublattice pair) / neighbor-sublattice concentration
convention.pair_counts: directed periodic bonds; conditional probability normalized by observed center-species bonds

assumptions: Fixed cell, geometry, sublattice membership, and input composition.
Uniform coordination within each requested sublattice-pair shell.
Only explicit targets contribute; equal weights; shells are one-based per sublattice pair.
Integer capacities, periodic-bond multiplicity congruences, self-image restrictions, and binary cut parity are enforced.
count_step=0 denotes a fixed count; otherwise admissible counts equal count_offset modulo count_step.
Completed joint blocks enforce neighbor totals and reciprocity on each identical bond graph; capped blocks fall back to independent bounds.
Different bond graphs and full occupation realizability remain relaxed; joint count tables are not enumerated structures.
A zero lower bound alone does not establish feasibility. Certification requires the supplied witness to attain it.
These are SRO-error bounds, not bounds on decorated figure-correlation or native weighted bond-count objectives.

diversity.selection: Lowest-error anchor, then greedy farthest-point RMS distance; equal component weights; no variance rescaling.

limitations: Fixed geometry and compositions; distinct under verified label- and target-preserving parent-cell symmetries. No species relabeling.
A bounded candidate pool and greedy selection do not guarantee globally maximal diversity or discovery of every eligible structure.
Distinct structures can share the same descriptor vector; zero descriptor distance does not imply structural equivalence.
No thermodynamic sampling distribution or statistical uncertainty estimate; spread describes only the selected configurations.
Time limit is cooperative, includes preparation and collection, excludes final selection/export; library calls can overrun.
